name: magnetic-dock
title: Magnetic Dock
summary: A floating app launcher that enlarges the item nearest a pointer while preserving predictable keyboard navigation.
useWhen: A small set of primary destinations benefits from compact, visually expressive bottom navigation.
Desktop and pointer-first interfaces need faster targeting without adding a persistent sidebar.
avoidWhen: The navigation has enough destinations that labels must be continuously visible.
Mobile navigation needs platform-specific tab semantics and large fixed touch targets.
capabilities: Action callbacks for button items and composed pointer handlers
Configurable item size, range, and magnification
accessibility: Each item has an accessible label and a visible focus label.
Uses native anchors or buttons for keyboard interaction.

motion.purpose: Increase the pointer-nearest target to make scanning and selection feel direct without moving the dock itself.
motion.reducedMotion: Keep all targets and labels available while removing pointer-driven magnification.
